title: Catalog card
responsibility: Shows one catalog entity; page cards contain only a title and its recorded screenshot or planned design.

inputs.name: EntityCard.entity
inputs.description: The catalog entity to show, one item of the shown project's catalog. Its category sets the layout, and the card reads its id, title, summary, kind, latestVersion, hasPlan, verification, verificationNote and thumbnail: a functions entity never shows a picture, and a null thumbnail on any other entity shows a text placeholder in place of the picture.

examples.title: PlanBadge
examples.summary: Shows the Plan marker that a catalog entity carries when it has a design proposal.
examples.verificationNote: No complete verification for this entity at this commit has been loaded.

examples.title: Harness catalog
examples.summary: Lists the catalog of the shown project, one card for each entity.
examples.verificationNote: No complete verification for this entity at this commit has been loaded.

examples.title: EvidenceGrid
examples.summary: Shows the screenshots of a unit's states and viewports in one grid.
examples.verificationNote: No complete verification for this entity at this commit has been loaded.

inputs.name: EntityCard.workspace
inputs.description: The workspace store of the shown project, a WorkspaceState instance: its loaded revision commit is the commit that design images are read at, and its path() builds every link on the card. Until a snapshot is loaded, path() returns '/' and no design image is requested, and no image is requested while no bridge is connected.

outputs.name: EntityCard
outputs.description: The card article, with class entity-card and also planned when the entity has a plan: a function without a plan is one link around its title, a page is one link around its explorer name and thumbnail, and any other entity shows its explorer name, its plan badge if it has a plan, its summary, a picture (none for a function), its version or kind label, a verification icon and a review or open link. Recorded previews are labelled 'Recorded preview of <name>' with the image alt 'Screenshot of <name>', where <name> is the explorer name, and loaded design images carry the alt text '<title> design <version>'.
